connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source:
A list of additional `host:port` pair strings to use for establishing the initial connection to the Kafka cluster to be used in addition to the main server provided in the connection URL. The client will make use of all servers irrespective of which servers are specified here for bootstrapping; this list only impacts the initial hosts used to discover the full set of servers.

This list should be in the form `host1:port1,host2:port2,...`

Since these servers are just used for the initial connection to discover the full cluster membership (which may change dynamically), this list need not contain the full set of servers (you may want more than one, though, in case a server is down).
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message:
用於建立與 Kafka 群集初始連接的額外 `host:port` 對字串清單，將與連接 URL 中提供的主要伺服器一併使用。客戶端將使用所有伺服器，無論此處指定的伺服器為何；此清單僅影響用於發現完整伺服器集合的初始主機。

此清單應為 `host1:port1,host2:port2,...` 格式

由於這些伺服器僅用於初始連接以發現完整的群集成員資格（可能動態變更），因此此清單無需包含全部伺服器（不過建議多於一個，以防某台伺服器離線）

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source:
The producer will attempt to batch records together into fewer requests whenever multiple records are being sent to the same partition. This helps performance on both the client and the server. This configuration controls the default batch size in bytes.

No attempt will be made to batch records larger than this size.

Requests sent to brokers will contain multiple batches, one for each partition with data available to be sent.

A small batch size will make batching less common and may reduce throughput (a batch size of zero will disable batching entirely). A very large batch size may use memory a bit more wastefully as we will always allocate a buffer of the specified batch size in anticipation of additional records
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message:
生產者會嘗試將發送到相同分區的多筆記錄合併成較少的請求，以提升客戶端與伺服器的效能。此設定控制預設批次大小（位元組）。

超過此大小的記錄將不會被合併。

發送到代理的請求將包含多個批次，每個批次對應一個有資料可發送的分區。

較小的批次大小會降低合併頻率，可能降低吞吐量（批次大小為零將完全停用合併）。過大的批次大小可能稍微浪費記憶體，因為我們會預先配置指定大小的緩衝區以應付額外的記錄

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source:
JAAS login context parameters for SASL connections in the format used by JAAS configuration files.

JAAS configuration file format is described here. The format for the value is: `loginModuleClass controlFlag (optionName=optionValue)*;`.

For brokers, the config must be prefixed with listener prefix and SASL mechanism name in lower-case.

`listener.name.sasl_ssl.scram-sha-256.sasl.jaas.config=com.example.ScramLoginModule required;`
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message:
SASL 連線使用的 JAAS 登入內容參數，格式與 JAAS 設定檔相同。

JAAS 設定檔格式說明請見此處。值的格式為：`loginModuleClass controlFlag (optionName=optionValue)*;`。

對於代理伺服器，設定必須以監聽器前綴及小寫的 SASL 機制名稱為前綴。

`listener.name.sasl_ssl.scram-sha-256.sasl.jaas.config=com.example.ScramLoginModule required;`

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source:
The desired minimum time for the login refresh thread to wait before refreshing a credential, in seconds.

Legal values are between `0` and `900` (15 minutes); a default value of `60` (1 minute) is used if no value is specified.

This value and `sasl.login.refresh.buffer.seconds` are both ignored if their sum exceeds the remaining lifetime of a credential.

Currently applies only to `OAUTHBEARER`
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message:
登入重新整理執行緒在重新整理憑證前，希望等待的最短時間（單位：秒）。

合法值介於 `0` 和 `900`（15 分鐘）之間；若未指定值，則預設為 `60`（1 分鐘）。

若此值與 `sasl.login.refresh.buffer.seconds` 之和超過憑證剩餘有效時間，則兩者皆被忽略。

目前僅適用於 `OAUTHBEARER`

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source: SASL Login Refresh Minimum Period Seconds
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: SASL 登入重新整理最小間隔（秒）

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source: Minimum interval between credential refreshes, in seconds
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: 憑證重新整理之間的最小間隔（單位：秒）

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source:
The amount of buffer time before credential expiration to maintain when refreshing a credential, in seconds.

If a refresh would otherwise occur closer to expiration than the number of buffer seconds then the refresh will be moved up to maintain as much of the buffer time as possible.

Legal values are between `0` and `3600` (1 hour); a default value of `300` (5 minutes) is used if no value is specified.

This value and `sasl.login.refresh.min.period.seconds` are both ignored if their sum exceeds the remaining lifetime of a credential.

Currently applies only to `OAUTHBEARER`
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message:
重新整理憑證時，於憑證到期前維持的緩衝時間（單位：秒）。

若重新整理時間將接近到期時間，且小於緩衝秒數，則重新整理時間將提前，以盡可能維持緩衝時間。

合法值介於 `0` 和 `3600`（1 小時）之間；若未指定值，則預設為 `300`（5 分鐘）。

若此值與 `sasl.login.refresh.min.period.seconds` 之和超過憑證剩餘有效時間，則兩者皆被忽略。

目前僅適用於 `OAUTHBEARER`

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source: SASL Login Refresh Buffer Seconds
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: SASL 登入重新整理緩衝秒數

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source: Refresh buffer before credentials expire, in seconds
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: 憑證到期前重新整理緩衝時間（秒）

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source:
Login refresh thread will sleep until the specified window factor relative to the credential's lifetime has been reached, at which time it will try to refresh the credential.

Legal values are between `0.5` (50%) and `1.0` (100%) inclusive; a default value of `0.8` (80%) is used if no value is specified.

Currently applies only to `OAUTHBEARER`
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message:
登入重新整理執行緒將休眠，直到指定的視窗係數達到憑證有效期間的相對比例，此時將嘗試重新整理憑證。

合法值介於 `0.5`（50%）與 `1.0`（100%）之間（含）；若未指定值，則預設使用 `0.8`（80%）。

目前僅適用於 `OAUTHBEARER`

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source: SASL Login Refresh Window Factor
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: SASL 登入重新整理視窗係數

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source: Credential lifetime fraction before the next login refresh
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: 下次登入重新整理前的憑證有效期間比例

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source:
The maximum amount of random jitter relative to the credential's lifetime added to the login refresh thread's sleep time.

Legal values are between `0` and `0.25` (25%) inclusive; a default value of `0.05` (5%) is used if no value is specified.

Currently applies only to `OAUTHBEARER`
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message:
登入重新整理執行緒休眠時間中，相對於憑證有效期間所加入的最大隨機抖動量。

合法值介於 `0` 與 `0.25`（25%）之間（含）；若未指定值，則預設使用 `0.05`（5%）。

目前僅適用於 `OAUTHBEARER`

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source: SASL Login Refresh Window Jitter
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: SASL 登入重新整理視窗抖動

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source: Maximum random refresh delay as a credential lifetime fraction
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: 以憑證有效期間比例表示的最大隨機重新整理延遲

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: 用於客戶端連接的 SASL 機制。這可以是任何有安全提供者可用的機制。預設為 GSSAPI

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: SASL 機制

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: 用於客戶端連接的 SASL 機制

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source:
A comma-separated list of cipher suites. This is a named combination of authentication, encryption, MAC and key exchange algorithm used to negotiate the security settings for a network connection using TLS or SSL network protocol.

By default all the available cipher suites are supported
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message:
以逗號分隔的密碼套件清單。這是用於 TLS 或 SSL 網路協定交談網路連線安全設定的驗證、加密、MAC 和金鑰交換演算法的命名組合。

預設情況下支援所有可用的密碼套件

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source: SSL Cipher Suites
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: SSL 密碼套件

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source: A comma-separated list of cipher suites
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: 以逗號分隔的密碼套件清單

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source:
A comma-separated list of protocols enabled for SSL connections.

The default is `TLSv1.2,TLSv1.3`.

With the default value, clients and servers will prefer `TLSv1.3` if both support it and fallback to `TLSv1.2` otherwise (assuming both support at least `TLSv1.2`). This default should be fine for most cases. Also see the config documentation for `ssl.protocol`
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message:
啟用 SSL 連接的協定清單，以逗號分隔。

預設值為 `TLSv1.2,TLSv1.3`。

使用預設值時，若雙方皆支援 `TLSv1.3`，客戶端與伺服器將優先使用；否則回退至 `TLSv1.2`（假設雙方至少支援 `TLSv1.2`）。此預設值對大多數情況皆適用。另請參閱 `ssl.protocol` 的設定文件

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source: SSL Protocols
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: SSL 協定

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source: A comma-separated list of protocols enabled for SSL connections
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message: 用於 SSL 連接的啟用協定清單，以逗號分隔

connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.source:
The SSL protocol used to generate the `SSLContext`.

The default is `TLSv1.3`. This value should be fine for most use cases.

With the default value for this config and `ssl.enabled.protocols`, clients will downgrade to `TLSv1.2` if the server does not support `TLSv1.3`.

If this config is set to `TLSv1.2`, clients will not use `TLSv1.3` even if it is one of the values in `ssl.enabled.protocols` and the server only supports `TLSv1.3`
connection.S2Fma2FEYXRhUHJvdmlkZXI.schem.message:
用於建立 `SSLContext` 的 SSL 通訊協定。

預設值為 `TLSv1.3`，適用於大多數情況。

此設定與 `ssl.enabled.protocols` 均採用預設值時，若伺服器不支援 `TLSv1.3`，用戶端會降級使用 `TLSv1.2`。

若此設定設為 `TLSv1.2`，用戶端就不會使用 `TLSv1.3`，即使該版本已列入 `ssl.enabled.protocols`，且伺服器僅支援 `TLSv1.3` 也是如此。
